purpose: Teach: 多少なりとも/殊に/ドロドロ/帰り際/頷い/はおり/わきまえ/大人しく

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、多少なりともお客様のお力になれたらいいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — I hope we can be of help to our customers in whatever small way we can.
lines.style: Soft opening, almost to herself. Warm and sincere without seeking validation. A gentle exhale mid-thought. Quiet conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、殊にコーヒーの香りを大事にされるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — our customers really do care about the coffee's aroma, don't they? It's something special.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observant tone. Pause before the second sentence, taking in the detail. Not questioning — reflecting out loud, steadily. Genuine noticing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、雨でお店の入口がドロドロね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — the rain's made the shop entrance pretty muddy today.
lines.style: Light, wry observation. A small smile in the voice. Not complaining — just naming what's there with a touch of gentle humor.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、帰り際に「美味しかった」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — when that customer left, they said 'that was delicious,' you know?
lines.style: Warmth rising toward the end. A quiet lift of satisfaction. Sharing the moment without overselling it. Small, genuine pleasure in being heard.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、こちらの説明に頷いて下さったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — and when we explained things, they nodded along with us.
lines.style: Gentle confirmation in the tone. A small nod implied in the voice. Building on the previous moment — things going right. Steady and warm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、冬はお客様、はおりを脱ぎ着しやすい席を作りましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — in winter, we should set up seats where customers can easily take their jackets off and on.
lines.style: Practical suggestion delivered warmly. Not directive — collaborative. A thought that moves into action naturally. Clear but never commanding.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新人さんも、お客様への礼儀をわきまえてるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — even the new staff member has good manners with the customers.
lines.style: Genuine praise, understated. A note of approval settling in. Not over-the-top — just noticing something done well and acknowledging it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お子様も、お店では大人しくしてくれて助かるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — and the children stay quiet in the shop — we're lucky for that, really.
lines.style: Grateful closing observation. Warm and appreciative without gushing. A small exhale of relief. The comfort of things working as they should.
